newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telepri sells 10 pct stake in Telecel.
newsitem.headline: Telepri sells 10 pct stake in Telecel.

text.p: Telepri, a holding comprising the Espirito Santo and Amorim groups, sold a 10 percent stake in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel to a group of domestic and international investors, said an official of Banco Essi which participated in the share placement.
"The placement occurred yesterday, via a type of bookbuilding," the official told Reuters.
The official did not identify the domestic and international institutions that bought the Telecel stake.
The deal was priced at 14,500 escudos per share.
Telecel shares stood at 14,500 escudos, down 198, in volume of 2,726,310 shares on Lisbon bourse at 0910 GMT.
The joint lead managers in the share placement were Banco Essi, Lehman Brothers and SBC Warburg.
